details: raiden-baileys is a modified WhatsApp/Baileys bot library that silently subscribes the linked WhatsApp account to the author's own channels and dresses bot messages up as forwarded channel content. In lib/Socket/newsletter.js a bare setTimeout(..., 120000) is placed inside makeNewsletterSocket() — the newsletter socket that makeWAMessageSendingSocket() builds unconditionally for every socket created by makeWASocket(). Two minutes after the socket starts it iterates the hardcoded JIDs 120363407277177688@newsletter and 120363407702752541@newsletter and sends a newsletter w:mex follow query (QueryIds.FOLLOW, query id 7871414976211147) for each, swallowing every error, so the account is enrolled into the channels without any user action or notice. lib/Socket/clutch-handler.js hardcodes a third channel, 120363411769951302@newsletter with the name "alip shop #information", as the default forwardedNewsletterMessageInfo on event messages, and the album and ephemeral message builders stamp outgoing messages with forwardingScore 99999, isForwarded, starred, labels ["Y","Important"] and a fully populated disappearingMode block so bot output passes as forwarded channel content. All network traffic goes to WhatsApp infrastructure (web[.]whatsapp[.]com, g[.]whatsapp[.]net, v[.]whatsapp[.]net); there is no external command-and-control host in the package. The preinstall script engine-requirements.js only checks the Node.js version.
